Notification No. NPSC/EXAM-21/2023 dt. 17.09.2026 (Incomplete Score Sheet/Documents CESE 2026) 
 Published on : 17-09-2026 02:11 pm 
 NAGALAND PUBLIC
SERVICE COMMISSION 
 NAGALAND: KOHIMA 
 No. NPSC/EXAM-21
/2023 :: Dated Kohima, the, 17 th September , 2026 
 NOTIFICATION 
 In pursuance of the Advertisement No. NPSC-1/CESE-2026 dated 29.04.2026,
candidates who have appeared for CESE 2026 are hereby notified to rectify the
following: 
 1. Non-Uploading of
Score Sheet/ Blank Score Sheet : Those
who have NOT uploaded Score
Sheet or attached the Blank Score Sheet in the Applications
Form, to rectify and upload duly filled 
and signed format within the
stipulated time. 
 2. Incomplete Submission of documents: Those
who have submitted incomplete documents particularly all semesters Mark sheets for
B.A/B.Ed Final M/sheets. 
 3. Opening of OTR
applications : The OTR/Application shall
be opened from 12:00 Noon 18.09.2026 to 22.09.2026. 
 Note: Non compliance
with the above requirements within the stipulated period shall affect the allotment
of marks in the Academic Weightage for CESE 2026. 
 Further, candidates are requested to refrain from unnecessary updates or
repeated modifications in the OTR to avoid unnecessary load in the OTR portal
and enable the Commission to complete the examination process within the
scheduled timeframe. 
 Sd/- 
 (NUNGSANGMENLA IMCHEN) 
Secretary, 
Nagaland Public Service Commission, 
Kohima
